data.name: Project Sol
data.detailed_description:
Project Sol is a colony simulator with a Sci-Fi twist. At its core, Project Sol tries to blur the line between classic management games like Rim World, and 4x strategy similar to Stellaris. Still in the very early stages of development, there are many features to come. Project Sol also gives you the ability to directly influence the Galaxy by applying unique Emperor Powers that can drastically shape the path your Empire takes.

What to expect:

  • Frequent updates. Development is daily, and ongoing.

  • Demo coming soon. 

  • Free patches for the core game.

Core Gameplay Features:

  • Management sim. Direct your workers, construct production satellites.

  • RTS. Build ships and defenses. Seek out enemies of the Empire and crush them.

  • Replay-ability. Each Galaxy is randomly generated. Enemies appear in different locations and employ various strategies.

Road Map:

  • Get a demo running before 9-30-26

  • Research system

  • Multiple Enemy types

  • End-Game enemies

  • Rogue elements

  • Acheivements

  • Much More!

data.short_description: Project Sol is a Sci-Fi colony sim set in the future when you civilization is just beginning to reach for the stars. Take control of your Empire, build massive orbital satellites, defend from roving pirates, and conquer the galaxy!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑2500K or AMD FX‑6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD HD 7870
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
